## Product Roadmap 2026-2027

Halvorsen Industrial Systems - Management - owner: Ritva Soininen

## 1. SmartFlow 2.0 platform

Planned release: Q2 2026. Scope: cloud analytics for pump fleets with predictive maintenance alerts.

Product owner: Christelle Renault. Development budget: EUR 3.2 million. Status: On track.

## 2. HX-700 high-pressure pump

Planned release: Q4 2026. Scope: new 700-series for desalination with 160 m maximum head.

Product owner: Constance Normand. Development budget: EUR 3.3 million. Status: On track.

## 3. CU-5 controller

Planned release: Q1 2027. Scope: next-generation controller with edge AI and IEC 62443 certification.

Product owner: Jose Angel Cerro. Development budget: EUR 3.4 million. Status: On track.

## 4. IE5 motor upgrade across HX range

Planned release: Q3 2026. Scope: ultra-premium efficiency motors on all HX models above 15 kW.

Product owner: Tatiana Maia. Development budget: EUR 3.4 million. Status: On track.

## 5. Kestrel actuator integration

Planned release: Q2 2027. Scope: bundle smart valve actuators with HX pumps (subject to Project Nordlys).

Product owner: Tola Kurtyka. Development budget: EUR 1.0 million. Status: On track.
